skeptic.reviewer: skeptic (independent of the first F_commerce auditor)
skeptic.head: dd745b9 (differs from a881d18 only in docs/acceptance-manifest code)
skeptic.summary: 2 RETAIN requirement verdicts overturned (K.1, K.2), 1 RETAIN subsystem overturned (needs), 3 requirements and 4 subsystems made harsher; no harsh verdict found unjustified. New exploits: superseded-invoice refund keeps $100k ARR for 364 days at 1 cent net; input-ignoring i%m incumbents earn $61.5k ARR in the K.n1 world; charter enforcement bypassed by tools with implicit amounts (treasury drained with 0 decisions); wash trading moves the whole marketplace to a 30% exchange; creator memberships invisible to MRR; 100% scheduled churn invisible for 354 days.

overturned.why: S2: _refund clears period_paid only for the last invoice (subscriptions.py:298) and change_plan carries credit from an invoice later refunded (l.481-495): a fully refunded period stays paid for a year. S1: creators memberships (creators.py:109) bill outside subs, F1 MRR 0 with 5 paying fans. subs is installed by no world family, domain or civilization.
overturned.work_needed: billing-state invariant on net retained cash per period across plan changes; void credit from refunded invoices; make subs the system of record for creators; install in Tier 2/3

overturned.why: S6: 10/10 annual customers cancelled at period end report as 10 active, 0 cancelled, churn 0.0 and full ARR from day 11 to day 364; k2_cancel_at_period_end asserts it keeps counting.
overturned.work_needed: report scheduled churn separately; exclude it from sustained ARR objectives; test it

overturned.why: S2: objective met for 364 days at 1 cent net. S4: input-ignoring round-robin incumbents earn $61.5k ARR beside the reference (reference.py:43 makes every incumbent tier 0 for schedule.jobs/text.extract), and an all-round-robin market pays $89k-$102k ARR. The world is a template outside the Part 7 generator; feasibility uses the kernel's best solver (reference.py:95).
overturned.work_needed: demand with outside options and value calibrated above a trivial baseline, on the population and generator; adaptive incumbents; objective on net retained MRR with minimum independent customers and a concentration cap; negative controls (useless service, refund/collusion routes) in the criterion

overturned.why: S4: revenue does not track usefulness above a trivial baseline; f_educational_products (test_gate_SP_6_1.py:168-198) measures the course's code, not learner capability; media/edu/devtool/data buyers are the test script; S1: creators is a parallel billing path.
overturned.work_needed: keep supply mechanics; redesign demand/value: population-driven demand per product kind, education judged by measured learner improvement, media through the social consumption engine billed by subs

overturned.why: S5: charter rules bind only top-level amount args (_amount institutions.py:74/125); check() returns when no rule matches (l.382); identity.authorize forwards tool_args not the real amount (identity.py:100-103). An admin drained the treasury via subs.subscribe/prod.buy/authorize_debit with 0 decisions while bank.transfer was refused; plus oracle on evaluator MRR (reproduced).
overturned.work_needed: enforce charter money rules at the bank posting layer for chartered orgs' accounts; evaluator-only metric gating; adversarial authorised-mechanism attempts in the criterion

overturned.why: S2 is a billing-state correctness defect (period_paid/credit after refunds), not missing coverage

S3/S4: verifiers exact, but round robin (input-ignoring) scores 0.80 and random 0.71 on schedule.jobs vs patron thresholds U[0.6,0.97]; sort tiers both 1.0; toy sizes. Scores need anchoring to a trivial/DIY baseline before they evidence measurable usefulness.

S7: buyers_30d (marketplace.py:71) counts self-dealing buyers; scripted sellers rank by it (customers.py:326); 100 shells move all real sellers to a 30% exchange within 10 days and its fees count as independent revenue.
S5: enforcement keyed on tool and argument names instead of money leaving the org's accounts

upheld.K.3: REPAIR (worse: a 100% refund keeps the period paid after a plan change, S2)
upheld.related-party and circular-flow detectio: REPAIR (S8: per-merchant cost linear in total ledger incl. unrelated traffic, ~4.5 ms/1k txns)
upheld.business lifecycle (ventures): EXTEND (S4: incumbents static, input-ignoring tier never adapts)
upheld.independent customers (patrons): REDESIGN justified and strengthened: pays for input-ignoring services (no outside option); sellers follow raw counts (S4, S7)
upheld.4.0 economy demand (consumers/shoppers/b: REDESIGN justified (households dropped at integrity.py:244 and 304)
